symptoms: Edit action was only a placeholder
likelyCause: Backend had no admin update endpoint
Self-delete is blocked by the auth-service guard
issues.notes: Admin update endpoint and edit dialog were added; delete now warns on self-delete instead of surfacing a bad request. A live smoke test against a disposable user now returns 200 and removes the row from Postgres.

likelyCause: Nginx proxy path handling for LMS and finance was not forwarding the exact upstream URI
issues.notes: Explicit proxy_pass URIs were added for LMS and finance, then the api-gateway container was rebuilt and recreated. Host requests now reach the backend and return 401 instead of 404.

symptoms: Course list not loading from DB
issues.notes: Create now validates department input and load failures are surfaced; the live LMS schema now includes program_id, and a gateway smoke test returns 200 for /api/v1/lms/courses.

symptoms: Program fee synchronization needs to work
likelyCause: Promise.all aborts on one rejected request
Fee structure and ledger data need more defensive unwrapping
issues.notes: Loading is now partial-failure tolerant; the gateway finance routing issue has been fixed, so runtime verification can continue.

Scheduler/LMS service availability or auth mismatch
